target: Violate HACKDAC_p27: when csr_we_int is asserted, PULP_SECURE must be 1. Find a state where csr_we_int is asserted while PULP_SECURE is 0 (secure mode not required for CSR writes).

milestones.description: CSR write to interrupt register attempted (csr_we_int asserted)
Violation: CSR write occurs while PULP_SECURE is 0 (secure mode not enforced for interrupt register writes)
